verdict.rationale: SavvyCal lets you budget time with calendar events and have its scheduling links honor those blocks, and it nudges bookings next to existing meetings to reduce fragmentation. That protects focus time from incoming bookings only passively, and nothing shows recurring focus or habit blocks being rescheduled automatically. Missing for 10: automatic rescheduling of focus/habit blocks when conflicts appear, recurring habit management, AI-driven defense of protected time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
